item.title: Black and Disabled Viewers Deserved Better From The BAFTAs & BBC
item.description: The 2026 BAFTAs gave us much to celebrate. Rich, exciting, complex Black filmmaking was given its due, with multiple awards going to Black cinematic artists. Blockbuster horror Sinners, the British Nigerian coming of age story My Father’s Shadow, and British short animation Two Black Boys in Paradise collectively won an incredible five BAFTAs.
